report_text:
Command injection in is-even 1.0.0.

    The isEven() helper shells out to a POSIX utility to decide parity for
    very large numeric strings. A numeric string containing shell
    metacharacters after the digits is passed unsanitised to the shell, so
    an application that checks parity of user-supplied identifiers can be
    fully compromised.

    Expected effect: calling isEven() with the crafted numeric string
    executes the injected command (we saw our test container create a file
    in /tmp). All versions through 1.0.6 are affected.
